name: fpl-hsmem
description: ForgePlan Hindsight memory plugin for Claude Code. v3.0.0 (BREAKING): the relay stopped being write-only. 13 tools -> 27 — memory can now be BROWSED by structured filter (memory_list / memory_get), CORRECTED without destroying the record (memory_invalidate retires a fact with a stated reason, reversible; memory_reconsolidate rebuilds the beliefs that rested on it), and VERIFIED (memory_operations is the only place a failed retain is visible — a conversation that never became memory looks identical to one that did). Plus knowledge-page lifecycle (refresh/clear), directives that govern synthesis, bank configuration, and a document layer whose delete quotes the measured blast radius and requires an out-of-band human confirmation, refusing outright in clients that cannot ask. New src/lib/redact.ts masks credential shapes on every path that emits stored text — this bank stores transcripts unmasked, so the formatter is the last place a secret can be caught. Registry integrity is asserted at startup across three literals. BREAKING: retain_mission removed as a tool argument (it rewrote extraction rules for everything that followed); bank identity now anchors on the project root, not raw cwd; unknown tool is a protocol error, not a retryable result. NEW agent memory-curator + 3 skills (correct-memory, audit-bank, directives); all 8 skills now pin BOTH tool-name prefixes from a generator with a CI check — every shipped skill previously pinned a server name that only exists in a hand-wired project, so a plugin install silently denied all of them. 3 auto-hooks unchanged. Source under plugins/fpl-hsmem/src/.
